Instant control. Infinite creativity. 
 Unlock your creative potential with the Razer Stream Controller X. Designed to simplify your streaming and content creation process, this controller puts instant control and infinite creativity right at your fingertips. No more juggling multiple devices or struggling with complex setups. With the Stream Controller X, you can streamline your workflow and focus on engaging your fans and growing your following. 

 Control at your fingertips. 
 The controller features 15 Switchblade Buttons, which you can customize to create handy shortcuts for various tasks. Whether it's streaming, video editing, music production, or controlling your apps and lights, you can easily access and control them with just a few taps. The customizable icons and intuitive visual navigation make it effortless to find and activate the functions you need. 

 Automate your process. 
 Take automation to the next level with Multi-link Macros. By linking multiple actions to a single button, you can execute complex tasks with a simple press. Kickstart your stream, trigger simultaneous actions, or set up sequential operations—all at the push of a key. This feature saves you time and effort, allowing you to focus on delivering top-notch content. 

 Designed for efficient multi-tasking. 
 Efficient multi-tasking is made possible with the Stream Controller X's intuitive navigation and organization. You can sort and store as many actions as you want within a single button, creating custom profiles for different tasks. With Dynamic Mode enabled, the controller can automatically switch profiles based on the detected app, ensuring seamless transitions and optimized performance. 

 Compatible with leading streaming software 
 The Stream Controller X is compatible with leading streaming software, thanks to its partnership with Loupedeck Software. Get set up instantly with ready-made profiles for streaming, content creation, productivity, and more. The controller supports essential tools like Twitch, OBS Studio, Spotify, Razer Key Light Control, Razer Audio Mixer Control, and Voicemod. With the endless options available, you can tailor your setup to suit your specific needs and preferences. 

 Optimal viewing angel 
 Enjoy an optimal viewing angle during your streaming sessions with the detachable 50° Anti-slip Magnetic Stand. Simply snap on the controller for a secure fit that not only provides you with a clear view of all your buttons but also stays firmly in place during intense use, thanks to its grippy underside. 

 Compatible with leading streaming software Setting up your Stream Controller X is a breeze. Powered by Loupedeck, the controller offers an all-in-one setup experience via the Loupedeck marketplace. Discover a wide range of plugins, profiles, and icon packs that best suit your needs. Easily download and install them directly from the marketplace, ensuring you have all the tools necessary to elevate your streaming and content creation endeavors.

The MSI Cubi 5 Mini PC is a compact yet powerful computing solution designed for space-conscious users who need reliable performance. The Ultra 4K HD HDMI port supports high-resolution external displays for presentations or media consumption. The mini PC's compact form factor makes it ideal for small offices, home setups, or as a secondary machine in larger computing environments. whiteangel-1ktguua.description:
The Intel® Core™ i7-14700KF is one of Intel’s most advanced desktop CPUs, crafted for performance enthusiasts who need raw speed, multitasking power, and precise control. Built on the Raptor Lake Refresh architecture , this 14th Generation processor pushes desktop computing to a new level — blending cutting-edge hybrid technology with massive processing capability.

 🚀 Extreme Hybrid Architecture for Ultimate Speed 

 At its core, the i7-14700KF uses Intel’s powerful hybrid design that combines 8 Performance-cores (P-cores) and 12 Efficient-cores (E-cores) for a total of 20 cores and 28 threads . The Performance-cores deliver incredible single-threaded speed for gaming and demanding workloads, while the Efficient-cores handle background tasks and parallel operations with exceptional energy efficiency.

 With boost frequencies reaching up to 5.6 GHz , the i7-14700KF ensures instant responsiveness, faster load times, and smoother multitasking — whether you’re gaming, editing, streaming, or running professional applications.

 🎮 Designed for Elite Gaming 

 The i7-14700KF is a powerhouse for gaming enthusiasts. With its 20 core hybrid design and high turbo clocks, it delivers exceptional frame rates and low latency across all modern AAA titles. It ensures superior performance in competitive gaming, VR experiences, and high-refresh-rate monitors. Combined with a powerful discrete GPU, it eliminates bottlenecks, providing smooth and consistent gameplay.

 Since this is a KF variant , it does not include integrated graphics , making it perfect for systems that rely entirely on a dedicated GPU for rendering. This configuration allows the CPU to focus all its energy on raw processing performance.

 🧩 Unlocked for Overclocking Freedom 

 As an unlocked processor , the i7-14700KF gives you full control to customize your system’s performance. Using a compatible motherboard (Z690, Z790, or later), enthusiasts can tweak multipliers, voltages, and frequencies to achieve optimal performance. When paired with high-quality cooling, such as liquid cooling or advanced air solutions, the i7-14700KF can maintain incredible stability even when pushed beyond its rated specifications.

 Intel’s performance-tuning technologies — like Intel® Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU) and Thermal Velocity Boost — make it easier to unlock extra speed safely and efficiently.

 💼 Built for Creators and Professionals 

 Beyond gaming, the i7-14700KF is a true workhorse for creators and professionals. Its 20 cores and 28 threads make it a perfect fit for demanding workloads such as video editing, 3D rendering, AI computation, photo editing, and software development . Applications like Adobe Premiere Pro, Blender, and DaVinci Resolve benefit greatly from the processor’s high multi-core performance, while its superior single-core speed ensures quick rendering previews and faster export times.

 Thanks to Intel’s Thread Director technology , tasks are automatically distributed between P-cores and E-cores for maximum efficiency. This smart scheduling guarantees consistent responsiveness even under heavy multitasking conditions.

 ⚙️ Next-Generation Platform Support 

 The Intel® Core™ i7-14700KF supports both DDR5 and DDR4 memory, giving you flexibility to choose between cutting-edge performance or cost-effective configurations.

 
• 
 DDR5 support up to 5600 MT/s for next-generation speed.

• 
 DDR4 support up to 3200 MT/s for broad compatibility.

 
 Additionally, the processor offers PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 compatibility, enabling ultra-fast data transfer for the latest GPUs and NVMe SSDs. This ensures your system remains future-ready for years to come.

 🔥 Thermal Performance and Cooling Requirements 

 With a base power (TDP) of 125 W and a maximum turbo power of around 253 W, the i7-14700KF requires robust cooling to perform at its best. A premium air cooler or AIO liquid cooler is highly recommended, especially for overclocking enthusiasts.

Lunar Lake's hybrid architecture combines high-performance P-cores with efficient E-cores — delivering fast, responsive single-threaded performance for business applications alongside smooth background task management across simultaneous workloads.  - 60Hz refresh rate: standard smooth motion for all office and productivity use

 - 14ms response time: adequate for all business applications

 - Borderless design: slim NanoEdge-style bezels maximising screen presence within the AIO footprint

 - Low blue light + flicker-free: TÜV Rheinland certified — independent validation of eye comfort during extended daily use

 

 8GB DDR5 — FAST, EFFICIENT SYSTEM MEMORY

 DDR5 system memory delivers higher bandwidth and lower power consumption than DDR4 — improving multitasking responsiveness across Microsoft 365, browser sessions, video calls, ERP/CRM tools, and background process management simultaneously. Expandable via the two DDR5 SO-DIMM slots for users requiring additional memory capacity.

 

 512GB PCIe 3.0×4 NVMe M.2 2280 SSD

 The 512GB M.2 PCIe NVMe SSD delivers fast Windows boot, quick application launch, and responsive file access throughout the working day. PCIe NVMe's superior sequential and random read/write performance over SATA SSDs reduces operating system overhead and application load times — keeping the neo 50a Gen 6 consistently responsive under mixed daily workloads.

 

 WI-FI 6 + BLUETOOTH — FAST, RELIABLE WIRELESS

MU-MIMO maintains stable connection quality across multiple simultaneous Wi-Fi 6 devices. Bluetooth 5.1/5.2 supports wireless peripherals and mobile device connectivity.

Intel Core i5-13400F RTX 5050 Gaming PC – 16GB RAM, 500GB NVMe SSD

 Powerful 1080p Gaming PC with Intel and NVIDIA Performance

 The Intel Core i5-13400F RTX 5050 Gaming PC is built for gamers who want strong daily performance, smooth 1080p gaming, fast loading times, and a clean ARGB gaming look. This PC combines a modern Intel 13th Gen processor, a Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB graphics card, 16GB dual-channel DDR4 memory, and fast NVMe storage to deliver a balanced experience for gaming, multitasking, studying, office work, and entertainment.

 Processor Performance

 Intel Core i5-13400F – 10 Cores and 16 Threads

 At the heart of this system is the Intel Core i5-13400F , a 13th Generation processor designed with Intel hybrid architecture. It features 10 cores , including 6 Performance-cores and 4 Efficient-cores , with a total of 16 threads . This gives the PC strong performance for modern games, background applications, browsing, Discord, launchers, and productivity tasks.

 The processor can reach up to 4.60GHz Max Turbo Frequency and includes 20MB Intel Smart Cache , making it a powerful and reliable choice for a gaming PC in this category. Because this is an F-series processor , it does not include integrated graphics, which makes it ideal for builds that use a dedicated graphics card like the RTX 5050.

 Graphics Card

 Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB

 Graphics performance is powered by the Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB GDDR6 . This GPU is designed for modern 1080p gaming, offering NVIDIA RTX technologies, AI-powered graphics features, and support for modern display standards. The Palit RTX 5050 Dual comes with 8GB GDDR6 memory , 2560 CUDA cores , a 128-bit memory interface , and modern outputs including HDMI and DisplayPort.

 Dual-Fan Cooling Design

 The Palit Dual cooling design uses a compact dual-fan layout to help keep the graphics card cool during gaming sessions. Its clean black design, dual-slot size, and efficient cooling structure make it suitable for gaming systems where airflow, space, and reliability matter.

 Motherboard

 ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4

 The system is built on the ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4 , a micro-ATX motherboard using the Intel H610 chipset and LGA1700 socket . It supports Intel 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen processors, DDR4 memory, PCIe 4.0 for the graphics card, M.2 storage, SATA storage, Realtek Ethernet, USB connectivity, and essential ASUS protection features.

 Stable ASUS Protection Features

 ASUS PRIME motherboards are designed for stability and everyday reliability. This board includes practical protection and durability features such as ASUS 5X Protection III, DIGI+ VRM control, LANGuard, and SafeSlot Core, helping improve long-term system stability for gaming and daily use.

 Memory and Storage

 16GB Lexar THOR DDR4 RAM

 This PC includes 16GB Lexar THOR DDR4 RAM , installed as 2x8GB for dual-channel performance. Dual-channel memory helps improve system responsiveness and gaming performance compared to single-stick configurations. Lexar THOR DDR4 memory supports Intel XMP 2.0 and uses an aluminum heat spreader designed to help with airflow and heat dissipation.

 The RAM kit is listed as 3600MHz . However, because the ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4 officially supports DDR4 memory up to 3200MHz, the actual running speed may depend on BIOS settings, CPU memory controller support, and compatibility.

 Kingston NV3 500GB NVMe SSD

 Storage is handled by the Kingston NV3 500GB NVMe SSD , a fast PCIe NVMe drive designed for quick Windows boot times, faster game loading, and smoother everyday use. Compared to traditional hard drives, NVMe storage gives the system a much faster and more responsive feel when opening applications, launching games, transferring files, and using Windows.

 Cooling and Power

 DeepCool AG400 CPU Cooler

 The CPU is cooled by the DeepCool AG400 , a single-tower air cooler with a 120mm PWM fan and four heat pipes. This cooler is a strong upgrade over basic stock cooling

The Lenovo ThinkCentre neo 50a Gen 6 27" is a slim, space-saving All-in-One business PC built for professionals, SMB teams, and home-office power users who require a larger display surface, enterprise-grade security, and capable everyday performance — without a separate tower or cable cluster. Powered by Intel's Lunar Lake Core 5-210H processor with Intel Arc integrated graphics, 16GB DDR5, a 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD, and a 27-inch Full HD IPS display — it delivers a complete, wall-mountable business workstation in a single chassis. The 27" panel and doubled RAM over the 24" variant make it the productivity-first choice for multi-application workflows, split-screen working, and content-review tasks.

 

 INTEL CORE 5-210H — LUNAR LAKE, 8 CORES, UP TO 4.80GHz

 The Intel Core 5-210H is a Lunar Lake-platform processor featuring 8 cores, 8 threads, 12MB cache, and a boost frequency up to 4.80GHz. The hybrid architecture combines high-performance P-cores for demanding foreground workloads with efficient E-cores for background task parallelism — delivering responsive performance across Microsoft 365, browser-heavy multitasking, video calls, ERP/CRM platforms, and cloud-based productivity applications. The integrated Intel AI Boost NPU enables Windows Studio Effects for AI-accelerated webcam processing including background blur and auto-framing.

 

 INTEL ARC GRAPHICS — LUNAR LAKE INTEGRATED GPU

 The Core 5-210H integrates Intel Arc 100V graphics — the dedicated GPU architecture of the Lunar Lake platform, substantially outperforming legacy Intel UHD Graphics in GPU-accelerated workloads. Intel Arc handles smooth 4K video playback, AV1 hardware encode/decode, hardware-accelerated rendering in Adobe applications, and dual external display output via HDMI 2.1. DirectX 12 Ultimate support enables hardware ray tracing for compatible applications.

 

 27" FHD IPS DISPLAY — NON-TOUCH, 1920×1080, HARDWARE LOW BLUE LIGHT

 The 27-inch Full HD IPS panel delivers 78% more screen area than the 24" model — a meaningful productivity upgrade for split-screen workflows, multi-window document editing, spreadsheet analysis, video review, and any task where display real estate directly impacts working efficiency:

 - IPS panel: consistent colour accuracy and wide viewing angles across the full 27" surface

 - 1920×1080 FHD at 27": 81 PPI — clear, sharp visuals at standard desk viewing distances

 - 250–300 nits brightness: clear output in standard office and home lighting

 - 60Hz refresh rate: standard smooth motion for all business and productivity workloads

 - Hardware-level Low Blue Light: physical reduction of blue light emission at the panel level — genuine eye protection without software colour shift, TÜV Rheinland certified

 - Flicker-Free: hardware backlight stability eliminating imperceptible high-frequency flicker that causes eye fatigue during extended sessions

 - Borderless design: slim bezels maximising screen presence within the AIO footprint

 - Non-touch: standard office glass surface — no touchscreen

 

 16GB DDR5 — DOUBLE THE STANDARD 8GB CONFIGURATION

 At 16GB DDR5, this configuration doubles the RAM of the standard 8GB neo 50a config — providing ample headroom for simultaneous multi-application business workflows, browser sessions with multiple tabs, virtual machines, large Excel models, and background cloud sync without memory pressure or performance degradation. Expandable via SO-DIMM slots for further capacity upgrades.

 

 512GB PCIe 3.0×4 NVMe M.2 2280 SSD

 Fast NVMe SSD storage delivers quick Windows boot, responsive application launch, and efficient file access throughout the working day. An additional M.2 slot is available for future storage expansion without replacing the primary drive.

 

 5MP IR CAMERA — AI-BOOSTED, WINDOWS HELLO

 The 5-megapixel IR camera supports Windows Hello facial recognition for instant passwordless biometric login. AI-boosted camera processing — enabled by the Core 5-210H's integrated NPU

PC GAMING Intel Core i5-14400F RTX 5060 Ti – PNY 8GB GPU, 16GB DDR4 RAM, 500GB NVMe SSD

 Powerful Gaming PC with Intel Core i5 and RTX 5060 Ti Performance

 The PC GAMING Intel Core i5-14400F RTX 5060 Ti is a strong and balanced gaming desktop built for users who want smooth gaming performance, fast system response, reliable cooling, and a clean ARGB gaming design. This build combines a 14th Generation Intel Core processor, a PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB graphics card, 16GB dual-channel DDR4 memory, fast Kingston NV3 NVMe storage, a Thermalright 650W 80 Plus Gold power supply, and a DeepCool AG400 air cooler.

 This PC is suitable for 1080p gaming, esports titles, online multiplayer games, daily work, school use, browsing, streaming, and multitasking. It is designed for gamers who want a modern ready-to-use system with trusted components from Intel, PNY, ASUS, Lexar, Kingston, Thermalright, DeepCool, and Thermaltake.

 Processor Performance

 Intel Core i5-14400F – 10 Cores and 16 Threads

 At the heart of this gaming PC is the Intel Core i5-14400F , a 14th Generation desktop processor designed for strong gaming and daily performance. It features 10 cores , including 6 Performance-cores and 4 Efficient-cores , with a total of 16 threads . This hybrid core design helps the system handle games, background applications, web browsing, launchers, Discord, and productivity software smoothly.

 The processor can reach up to 4.70GHz Max Turbo Frequency and includes 20MB Intel Smart Cache . It has a 65W processor base power and up to 148W maximum turbo power . Since this is an F-series processor , it does not include integrated graphics, making it ideal for a gaming PC that uses a dedicated GPU like the PNY RTX 5060 Ti.

 Graphics Card

 PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB

 Graphics performance is powered by the PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB . This GPU is based on NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and is designed for modern gaming, AI-enhanced graphics, and high-performance visual processing. The RTX 5060 Ti 8GB features 4608 CUDA cores , 8GB video memory , PCIe 5.0 support , and NVIDIA RTX technologies such as ray tracing, DLSS 4, and AI-accelerated performance features.

 The RTX 5060 Ti is a strong choice for gamers who want better performance than entry-level cards while keeping the build efficient and balanced. It is well suited for high-refresh 1080p gaming and can also handle many 1440p games depending on the title and settings.

 PNY Cooling and Gaming Design

 PNY offers RTX 5060 Ti 8GB models with gaming-focused cooling designs. Since the exact PNY model was not provided, the safest product wording is PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB without adding model-specific claims such as fan count, card length, RGB lighting, or factory overclock details unless the exact SKU is confirmed.

 Motherboard

 ASUS PRIME B760M-R D4

 The system is built on the ASUS PRIME B760M-R D4 , an Intel B760 micro-ATX motherboard with the LGA1700 socket . It supports Intel 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen processors, making it a suitable match for the Intel Core i5-14400F.

 This motherboard supports DDR4 memory , PCIe 4.0 , two PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots , SATA 6Gb/s , Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet , HDMI output, front USB 5Gbps support, and Aura Sync. It gives the build a stronger platform than basic H610 boards, especially for users who want better storage expansion and faster wired networking.

 Stable ASUS Platform

whiteangel-pemdou.description:
AMD Ryzen7 7700 RTX 5060 Ti 8GB Gaming PC in Jordan

 The Ryzen7 7700 RTX 5060 Ti Gaming PC is a powerful AMD AM5 gaming desktop built for gamers who want stronger graphics performance, an 8-core Ryzen processor, high-speed DDR5 memory, fast PCIe 4.0 NVMe storage, Wi-Fi 7 connectivity and a modern upgrade-friendly platform.

 This configuration combines the AMD Ryzen7 7700 processor , PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB EPIC-X RGB Overclocked Triple Fan graphics card , MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI motherboard , 16GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 memory , Kingston NV3 1TB NVMe SSD , Thermaltake Smart BM3 Bronze 750W power supply , DeepCool AG400 PLUS CPU cooler , and a Huntkey G35 gaming case configured with three RGB fans .

 Ryzen7 7700 RTX 5060 Ti Gaming Performance

 AMD Ryzen 7 7700 Zen 4 Processor

 At the heart of this Gaming PC is the AMD Ryzen7 7700 , a Ryzen 7000 Series desktop processor based on AMD’s Zen 4 architecture .

 AMD officially specifies the Ryzen 7 7700 with 8 CPU cores and 16 threads , a base clock of 3.8GHz , and a maximum boost clock of up to 5.3GHz . It includes 32MB of L3 cache , 8MB of L2 cache and has a default TDP of only 65W .

 The processor uses AMD’s AM5 socket , supports AMD EXPO memory technology, Precision Boost Overdrive and Ryzen Master, and AMD officially lists B850 among its supported chipsets. It also includes basic integrated AMD Radeon Graphics, although gaming performance in this system is handled by the dedicated RTX 5060 Ti.

 PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB OC Triple Fan

 EPIC-X RGB Factory-Overclocked Graphics

 Graphics performance comes from the PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB EPIC-X RGB Overclocked Triple Fan , exact SKU VCG5060T8TFXXPB1-O .

 PNY officially specifies this card with 4,608 CUDA cores , 8GB GDDR7 memory , a 128-bit memory interface , 28Gbps memory speed and 448GB/s memory bandwidth . The GPU runs at a 2407MHz base clock and reaches a factory-overclocked 2692MHz boost clock .

 Maximum graphics power is rated at 180W , and the card uses a single 8-pin power connector . PNY recommends a 600W system power supply , while this Gaming PC uses a 750W Thermaltake unit.

 The card measures approximately 299 × 120 × 40mm and uses a two-slot triple-fan cooling design. It also provides three DisplayPort 2.1b outputs and one HDMI 2.1b output.

 The RTX 5060 Ti uses NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and supports current-generation GeForce technologies including DLSS, ray tracing and NVIDIA Reflex in compatible titles. Actual FPS will always vary depending on game, resolution, settings, drivers and updates.

 MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI Motherboard

 AM5, Wi-Fi 7, 5G LAN and PCIe 5.0

 The system is built around the MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI , a modern mATX motherboard using AMD’s B850 chipset and AM5 socket.

 MSI officially lists support for AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000 and 9000 Series processors , making it directly compatible with the Ryzen 7 7700.

 The motherboard provides four DDR5 DIMM slots , dual-channel memory operation and AMD EXPO support. MSI lists memory-overclocking support extending up to 8200+ MT/s in supported configurations, so DDR5-6000 falls comfortably within the motherboard’s capabilities.

 Storage expansion is particularly strong, with three M.2 slots . The primary slot supports up to PCIe 5.0 x4 , while the remaining slots provide additional NVMe expansion options.

 Networking is another major feature: MSI includes 5Gb Ethernet, Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 . With a Ryzen 7000 processor installed, the primary graphics slot can operate at PCIe 5.0 x16.

 16GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 RAM

 High-Speed DDR5 Memory

 This Gaming PC includes 16GB of G.SKILL DDR5 memory rated at 6000MT/s .

 G.SKILL officially offers 16GB DDR5-6000 modules and kits designed for modern DDR5 systems, including AMD-compatible products featuring EXPO profiles. G.SKILL notes that reaching the advertised DDR5-6000 speed requires compatible hardware and the appropriate BIOS memory profile.

 AMD Ryzen 7 9700X Performance

 At the heart of this gaming PC is the AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, a modern high-performance processor designed for smooth gaming, strong multitasking, and efficient productivity. It gives the system excellent speed for popular games, heavy browser use, Discord, streaming software, office programs, creative applications, and demanding daily workloads. This makes the PC suitable for users who want a powerful system for both gaming and professional work.

 The Ryzen 7 9700X is a great choice for gamers, streamers, students, designers, editors, and users who need strong daily performance. When paired with DDR5 memory, fast NVMe storage, and 360mm liquid cooling, the system feels fast, smooth, and stable from startup to gameplay. It delivers a strong balance between gaming performance, multitasking power, and modern platform support.

 GIGABYTE GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB Gaming OC Graphics

 The graphics card in this build is the GIGABYTE GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB Gaming OC 3 Fan, giving the PC strong graphics performance for modern gaming and creative workloads. The 16GB graphics memory gives users more room for modern games, high-resolution textures, creative applications, and future game updates. This makes the card a strong choice for users who want more GPU memory for gaming, editing, and multitasking.

 With the RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, users can enjoy smooth gameplay in esports titles, shooting games, racing games, open-world games, and modern AAA titles. The GIGABYTE Gaming OC design adds strong cooling, stable performance, and a premium look. The 3 fan cooling system helps keep the graphics card cooler during long gaming sessions, allowing the system to perform consistently under pressure.

 ASUS TUF B850-E WIFI Motherboard

 The ASUS TUF B850-E WIFI motherboard gives this gaming PC a strong and future-ready foundation. It supports AMD AM5 processors, DDR5 memory, fast NVMe storage, and modern connectivity features. The TUF series is known for durability, reliability, and clean gaming style, making it a great match for this Ryzen 7 gaming build.

 This motherboard is a strong choice for users who want stability, upgrade options, and modern performance. With the AM5 platform, users can upgrade later with stronger AMD processors, more RAM, and additional storage. WIFI support also gives the system cleaner and more flexible network connectivity for gaming, work, and daily use.

 32GB DDR5 6000MHz XSKY V-Color Memory

 This PC includes 32GB DDR5 6000MHz XSKY V-Color RAM, giving the system fast memory performance and strong multitasking power. The 32GB capacity is ideal for modern gaming, streaming, editing, browsing, office work, and creative applications. It gives users more headroom to keep multiple programs open while gaming or working without slowing down easily.

 DDR5 memory provides better bandwidth and improved speed compared to older DDR4 platforms, helping the PC feel smoother and more responsive in games, applications, and multitasking. With 32GB RAM, this build is more comfortable for users who want a system ready for heavier daily use and future software requirements.

With AM5 support, users can upgrade later with stronger AMD processors, more RAM, and additional storage. WIFI 7 support also adds modern wireless connectivity for users who want faster and cleaner network options.

 32GB DDR5 6000MHz XSKY V-Color Memory

It gives users more headroom to keep multiple programs open while gaming or working without slowing down easily.

It supports high-performance Intel processors, DDR5 memory, fast NVMe storage, and modern connectivity features. This motherboard is a strong match for the Intel Core i9-14900KF because it provides stability, upgrade options, and a clean professional platform for gaming and productivity.

 The Z790 platform is ideal for users who want a powerful PC with room for future upgrades. It gives the system strong support for high-speed components, additional storage, more memory, and advanced cooling setups. The MSI MPG design also adds a premium look inside the case, making the full build feel clean, powerful, and ready for modern performance.

whiteangel-1lbpagj.description:
Intel Core i9-14900KF RTX 5070 12GB Gaming PC in Jordan

 The i9-14900KF RTX 5070 Gaming PC is a premium high-performance desktop designed for gamers and demanding users who want flagship Intel processing power, modern NVIDIA Blackwell graphics, DDR5 memory and fast PCIe 4.0 NVMe storage.

 This configuration combines the Intel Core i9-14900KF , ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 , MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI motherboard , 32GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 memory , Kingston NV3 1TB NVMe SSD , MSI MPG A850GS PCIE5 850W 80 PLUS Gold power supply , DeepCool LE720 360mm ARGB liquid cooler , and the Thermaltake MH1 Full Glass chassis with seven fans .

 The result is a powerful platform suitable for modern gaming, heavy multitasking, streaming, productivity, creative workloads and demanding everyday PC use.

 i9-14900KF RTX 5070 Gaming Performance

 Intel Core i9-14900KF Processor

 At the heart of this Gaming PC is the Intel Core i9-14900KF , a 14th Generation Intel Core desktop processor.

 Intel officially specifies the i9-14900KF with 24 total cores and 32 threads , consisting of 8 Performance-cores and 16 Efficient-cores . The processor can reach a maximum turbo frequency of 6.0GHz and includes 36MB of Intel Smart Cache . It uses the LGA1700 socket and supports DDR5 memory up to 5600 MT/s at Intel’s standard specification level.

 The i9-14900KF carries a 125W processor base power specification and is designed for high-performance desktop workloads. Because this is a KF-series processor , it does not include integrated processor graphics, so graphics output is handled by the dedicated RTX 5070.

 With 24 cores and 32 threads, this processor gives the system substantial resources for gaming while also handling streaming applications, browser tabs, productivity software and demanding multitasking.

 ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB

 Triple-Fan NVIDIA Blackwell Graphics

 Graphics performance is provided by the ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 , standard model TUF-RTX5070-12G-GAMING .

 ASUS officially specifies 6,144 CUDA cores , 12GB GDDR7 memory , a 192-bit memory interface and 28Gbps memory speed. The standard model has a default Boost Clock of 2512MHz , while ASUS GPU Tweak III provides an optional 2542MHz OC Mode profile.

 The TUF card uses a large triple-fan design , measures 329 × 140 × 62.5mm , occupies approximately 3.125 slots and uses a single 16-pin power connector. ASUS recommends a 750W PSU for this card.

 This build uses an 850W Gold-rated MSI PSU, providing additional rated capacity above ASUS’s recommendation.

 The RTX 5070 platform supports current NVIDIA RTX technologies including DLSS, ray tracing and NVIDIA Reflex in compatible games and applications. Actual FPS will always vary according to resolution, graphics settings, driver version and individual game.

 MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI Motherboard

 Z790 DDR5 Platform with PCIe 5.0

 The system is built on the MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI , an ATX motherboard based on Intel’s Z790 chipset and LGA1700 socket.

 MSI officially supports compatible 12th, 13th and 14th Generation Intel Core processors , making this motherboard fully compatible with the i9-14900KF.

 The board features four DDR5 DIMM slots with capacity up to 256GB . MSI officially lists DDR5-6000 as a supported overclocked memory speed and supports Intel XMP 3.0 , making it an appropriate platform for the G.SKILL DDR5-6000 memory used in this system.

 For graphics expansion, the main PCIe slot supports PCIe 5.0 x16 directly from the CPU.

 Storage expansion is particularly strong, with four M.2 slots supporting PCIe 4.0 x4 drives plus six SATA 6Gb/s connectors. This gives plenty of room for future SSD upgrades beyond the installed Kingston NV3.

 Networking includes Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 , providing both fast wired and wireless connectivity.

 32GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 RAM

 High-Speed DDR5 Memory

 This Gaming PC includes 32GB of G.SKILL DDR5 memory rated at 6000 MT/s .
